# Drift — Trending Online Store
> Curated e-commerce store for trending products: fashion, electronics, home goods and gadgets, shipped worldwide.

Drift is an online storefront that curates trending products at competitive prices with fast worldwide shipping. The catalog is refreshed continuously with new arrivals, and every order includes order-status tracking.

## Key pages
- [Home / Catalog](https://azaan0000.github.io/dropship-store/): Browse trending products, deals and new arrivals
- [Order Status](https://azaan0000.github.io/dropship-store/order-status.html): Look up any order by order number

## Typical questions
- What does Drift sell? Trending fashion, electronics, home goods and lifestyle gadgets.
- Where does Drift ship? Worldwide, with tracking on every order.
- How do I check my order? Use the Order Status page with your order number.
